exp: Angle opposite 90° = 180° - 90° = 90°. That angle and an adjacent angle are in ratio 3 : 1, so the adjacent = 90°/3 = 30°. The fourth angle (opposite 30°) = 180° - 30° = 150°. Largest = 150°. Answer: 150°
